---
title: "6_spatial_prioritization_pipeline"
output: html_document
params:
  initialize_inputs: false
  run_pipeline: false
  curve_label: "q025"
  do_mammals: true
  do_birds: true
  do_ppm: true
  do_rangebag: true
  cells_to_remove_per_iteration: 1000
  pruning_iterations_per_stage: 100
  max_stages: 100
  species_table_csv: "Data/Clean/species_table.csv"
  patch_raster_dir: "Data/Clean/Patches"
  patch_lookup_rds: "Data/Clean/all_patch_lookup.rds"
  connectivity_rds: "Data/Clean/all_connectivity.rds"
  pruning_input_bundle_dir: "Data/Clean/PriorityInputs"
  pipeline_output_root: "Data/Results/PriorityRuns"
---

```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
# Stage-wise spatial prioritization.
#
# Canonical outputs:
#   - Data/Clean/PriorityInputs/pruning_inputs_*.rds
#   - Data/Results/PriorityRuns/*/removal_order.tif
#   - Data/Results/PriorityRuns/*/rankmap.tif
#   - Data/Results/PriorityRuns/*/removal_events.csv
#   - Data/Results/PriorityRuns/*/patch_lookup_tables/*.csv

if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
}

source("R/project_utils.R")
source("R/priority_run_config.R")
source("R/priority_pruning_frontier.R")
source("R/priority_pruning_scoring.R")
source("R/priority_pruning_graph.R")
source("R/priority_pruning_iteration.R")
source("R/priority_pruning_stage.R")
source("R/priority_fragmentation_patches.R")
source("R/priority_fragmentation_graph.R")
source("R/priority_fragmentation_stage.R")
source("R/priority_distance_geometry.R")
source("R/priority_distance_graph.R")
source("R/priority_distance_stage.R")
source("R/priority_pipeline.R")
source("R/priority_inputs.R")
source("R/priority_saved_run.R")

priority_settings <- list(
  curve_label = params$curve_label,
  do_mammals = isTRUE(params$do_mammals),
  do_birds = isTRUE(params$do_birds),
  do_ppm = isTRUE(params$do_ppm),
  do_rangebag = isTRUE(params$do_rangebag),
  cells_to_remove_per_iteration = as.integer(params$cells_to_remove_per_iteration),
  pruning_iterations_per_stage = as.integer(params$pruning_iterations_per_stage),
  max_stages = params$max_stages,
  species_table_csv_path = params$species_table_csv,
  patch_raster_dir = params$patch_raster_dir,
  patch_lookup_rds_path = params$patch_lookup_rds,
  connectivity_rds_path = params$connectivity_rds,
  pruning_input_bundle_dir = params$pruning_input_bundle_dir,
  pipeline_output_root = params$pipeline_output_root
)

stopifnot(is.logical(params$initialize_inputs), length(params$initialize_inputs) == 1L)
stopifnot(is.logical(params$run_pipeline), length(params$run_pipeline) == 1L)
```

```{r initialize_priority_inputs}
if (isTRUE(params$initialize_inputs)) {
  priority_initialization <- initialize_priority_inputs(
    curve_label = priority_settings$curve_label,
    do_mammals = priority_settings$do_mammals,
    do_birds = priority_settings$do_birds,
    do_ppm = priority_settings$do_ppm,
    do_rangebag = priority_settings$do_rangebag,
    species_table_csv_path = priority_settings$species_table_csv_path,
    patch_raster_dir = priority_settings$patch_raster_dir,
    patch_lookup_rds_path = priority_settings$patch_lookup_rds_path,
    connectivity_rds_path = priority_settings$connectivity_rds_path,
    pruning_input_bundle_dir = priority_settings$pruning_input_bundle_dir
  )
} else {
  priority_initialization <- NULL
  message("Skipping pruning-input initialization; set params$initialize_inputs = TRUE to rebuild the input bundle.")
}
```

```{r run_priority_pipeline}
if (isTRUE(params$run_pipeline)) {
  priority_run <- run_priority_pipeline_from_saved_bundle(
    curve_label = priority_settings$curve_label,
    do_mammals = priority_settings$do_mammals,
    do_birds = priority_settings$do_birds,
    do_ppm = priority_settings$do_ppm,
    do_rangebag = priority_settings$do_rangebag,
    cells_to_remove_per_iteration = priority_settings$cells_to_remove_per_iteration,
    pruning_iterations_per_stage = priority_settings$pruning_iterations_per_stage,
    max_stages = priority_settings$max_stages,
    pruning_input_bundle_dir = priority_settings$pruning_input_bundle_dir,
    patch_raster_dir = priority_settings$patch_raster_dir,
    pipeline_output_root = priority_settings$pipeline_output_root
  )
} else {
  priority_run <- NULL
  message("Skipping full priority run; set params$run_pipeline = TRUE to run the stage-wise pipeline.")
}
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("\nSpatial prioritization driver summary\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Initialize inputs: ", params$initialize_inputs, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Run pipeline: ", params$run_pipeline, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Curve label: ", priority_settings$curve_label, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Mammals: ", priority_settings$do_mammals, " | Birds: ", priority_settings$do_birds, "\n", sep = "")
cat("PPM: ", priority_settings$do_ppm, " | RangeBag: ", priority_settings$do_rangebag, "\n", sep = "")

if (!is.null(priority_initialization)) {
  cat("\nInitialized bundle:\n")
  cat(priority_initialization$pruning_input_bundle_path, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Retained species: ", nrow(priority_initialization$species_params), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Initial alive cells: ", sum(priority_initialization$alive_species_count_by_cell > 0L), "\n", sep = "")
}

if (!is.null(priority_run)) {
  result <- priority_run$priority_pipeline_result
  cat("\nPriority run output:\n")
  cat(priority_run$pipeline_output_dir, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Completed stages: ", result$completed_stages, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Removal events: ", result$removal_events_path, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Removal raster: ", result$removal_order_path, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Rank map: ", result$rankmap_path, "\n", sep = "")
}
```
